answer: In this PoA design, each agent’s reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, honest service rather than brief activity. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking reciprocal trust paths, they cannot amplify one another or pass consensus, whether they arrive as a gale, a whisper, or behind a lantern.
